items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: They lived upstairs. They had about three or four daughters and one son. Tony's one son

ctx.x: Well, did they take junk in those days? Did those fellas take junk in those days? Oh, yeah. They had junk back then. That's a terrible thing. I guess it was killing them off then like it was killing them all.

It wasn't as many. It wasn't as many them days as it is today. I lived over there 21 years at that corner house, with my wife. And I saw 95% of the dope addicts around here start off right on that corner. I know boys from a good family, swell boys. And I, you see, they had them big old doves. They'd keep them on the jaw like that. Of course, I'd have the light out. It'd be dark. And they're sitting on them. I step out of them sniff cocaine. I saw them shoot the needle right on that corner over there. See, on this…
